entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess the mission was a success.[n]All that's left is to see if he had a change[n]of heart or not.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, so bitter... Why'd you get it black?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The "Sayuri"...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're not gonna get all teary-eyed[n]and say stuff like, "Mom...!" are you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: To think that this painting was the source[n]of Madarame's distorted desires.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The only saving grace is that my mother[n]won't know of what transpired...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The genuine painting at his atelier[n]has been altered, after all...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ironic as it may be, this one here is[n]her true self-portrait now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's a wonderful painting.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And... although it took some time[n]it's in your hands now, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'm thankful for it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: However, it's impossible for this painting[n]to be acknowledged by society anymore...
That's a shame.
That's not a bad thing.
Was "Sayuri" your mom's name?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must inherit my mother's wishes[n]and improve myself even further.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You may be right...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Seeing my mother's expression here,[n]it's doubtful that she would've wished[n]for fame.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No. I doubt it's the name of any woman[n]in particular.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I bet it was to make it more mysterious—[n]just a part of Madarame's foolish staging.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, it would've been obvious that he[n]plagiarized it if he had used the real name.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So this is my mother... There's no way[n]that I would remember her face clearly...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But I was right about the rush of emotion[n]I felt when I saw this painting.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *buuurp*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Stop that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're so vulgar, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, what're you gonna do now? We're[n]gonna keep targetin' big shots.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Why do you do such things?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's to get back at scumbags and like...[n]society in general?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We also wanna give courage to[n]the people that're sufferin'[n]'cause of selfish adults.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Courage, hm... What good does that do?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You mean the courage to stand up for[n]themselves, correct? Will acquiring that[n]make them happy?
Probably...
I'm not sure.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yeah. There's no knowin' whether[n]it'll turn out good for everyone or not.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still, we won't know unless[n]we give it a try.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right. There's no knowing that. We just have[n]to give it a try.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...In other words, it all depends on[n]the person, hm?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then the same can be said about myself[n]right now. I also suffered because of[n]an adult's selfish act.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Moreover, if we investigate these Palaces,[n]it may expand my artistic repertoire.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You really only think about art, huh?[n]You're impressive.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well I won't take part in any inelegant[n]plans, all right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No worries! I've got us covered!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Plus, we have a rule that says we always[n]have to decide on a target unanimously.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I will try and live up to those[n]expectations.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then would you prefer I dress[n]as a woman?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Please don't.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At any rate, I'm curious... Another intruder[n]besides us, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Our only clue's a black mask, so that[n]doesn't necessarily mean it's just[n]one person, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But there's no way to check anymore.[n]The Palace is gone.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll try probing Madarame. I may be able[n]to learn something from him.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you sure? I mean—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'll contact you all if anything turns up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We should probably exchange our[n]contact info with you then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: An artist and a phantom thief... It seems[n]I'll be engaging in two trades from[n]here on...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well. You only live once, after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still, the incident about this other[n]intruder does concern me a little...
